The '''Boeus sector campaign''' was fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Rampant]]'' fought in the campaign, then headed to the [[Wroona Stardock]] for refit.<ref name="GNN9" />
